metadata.title: RackStack
metadata.description: PowerShell cmdlet wrappers around the RackStack.exe CLI. Invoke any of the 201 CLI actions (SelfTest, UpdateSelf, ExportLogs, Batch, every audit action, etc.) as structured cmdlets from scripts and pipelines. Auto-locates the installed EXE via the Programs-and-Features registry key, PATH, or the RACKSTACK_EXE environment variable. RackStack.exe is downloaded separately from https://github.com/TheAbider/RackStack/releases — the module itself is a thin wrapper, not the tool.

findings.title: Dynamic PowerShell code execution
findings.description: Dynamic evaluation can make a script harder to inspect and may enable downloaded or constructed code to run.

evidence.snippet: throw "RackStack.exe not found. Install via 'irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TheAbider/RackStack/master/Install-RackStack.ps1 | iex' -Install, set `$env:RACKSTACK_EXE, or add the EXE's directory to PATH."

findings.title: Network retrieval combined with code execution
findings.description: The same file contains both a network retrieval pattern and a dynamic execution pattern. This combination merits review and is not by itself proof of malicious intent.

evidence.snippet: $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'https://api.github.com/repos/TheAbider/RackStack/releases/latest' -Headers @{ 'User-Agent' = 'RackStack-PSGallery' } -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 15 -ErrorAction Stop  …  throw "RackStack.exe not found. Install via 'irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TheAbider/RackStack/master/Install-RackStack.ps1 | iex' -Install, set `$env:RACKSTACK_EXE, or add the EXE's directory to PATH."
